Home loan fees

An application fee of $600 is payable once, when the loan is approved. There is no monthly account fee on the Basic Home Loan. A discharge fee of $350 applies when the loan is repaid in full, and a rate lock fee of $395 applies if a fixed rate is locked at application for ninety days.

Fees are current at the date shown and can change. Government charges such as registration and stamp duty are separate and vary by state.
